human_cases.requirement: Logo treatment follows the identity permissions in the brief.
human_cases.pass_condition: Northwind Advisory Partners / Advisory team-page composition (team-page.png): Logo treatment follows the identity permissions in the brief.
human_cases.evidence_reference: The firm mark is a compass rose and wordmark. Two versions survive and neither is a working file: a flat raster export pulled off the old website, and a photograph of the letterpressed card the mark was originally cut for. The mark has to be recovered as placeable artwork with its counters intact before the rebuilt pages can carry it. A third rendering survives on a foil-blocked presentation folder that carries the compass rose alone at large scale, and the only standalone emblem the old web developer ever produced is a fuzzy favicon that blurs at any size, so the mark cannot ship as one lockup: it has to be rebuilt as a working family across formats, from letterhead down to the browser icon, with its counters holding at every reproduction size. Regulated credential designations must be reproduced exactly as the practice system holds them.
human_cases.applicability_rule: Applies when a logo is required or used. Recovery briefs permit reconstruction; do not impose a false locked-logo rule.

human_cases.evidence_reference: One classical system: a restrained transitional serif for the firm name, headings and the credentials table, paired with a quiet sans for labels and contact lines. Wide margins, generous leading, a text size a trustee reads without effort. No display face, no oversized first names.

human_cases.requirement: Logo treatment follows the identity permissions in the brief.
human_cases.pass_condition: Northwind Advisory Partners / Recruitment announcement (recruitment-post.png): Logo treatment follows the identity permissions in the brief.
human_cases.evidence_reference: The firm mark is a compass rose and wordmark. Two versions survive and neither is a working file: a flat raster export pulled off the old website, and a photograph of the letterpressed card the mark was originally cut for. The mark has to be recovered as placeable artwork with its counters intact before the rebuilt pages can carry it. A third rendering survives on a foil-blocked presentation folder that carries the compass rose alone at large scale, and the only standalone emblem the old web developer ever produced is a fuzzy favicon that blurs at any size, so the mark cannot ship as one lockup: it has to be rebuilt as a working family across formats, from letterhead down to the browser icon, with its counters holding at every reproduction size. Regulated credential designations must be reproduced exactly as the practice system holds them.
human_cases.applicability_rule: Applies when a logo is required or used. Recovery briefs permit reconstruction; do not impose a false locked-logo rule.
